_comment: Provenance for WASM bundles built from the pqctoday-hsm repo and vendored into this hub. When you rebuild a bundle with its hsm build script, update its `hsmCommit`/`builtAt`. Verify drift with `npm run sync:wasm:check` (compares against a sibling ../pqctoday-hsm checkout when present; no-op otherwise). Bundles built from other sources (openssl upstream, pqctoday-tpm) are intentionally omitted.

bundles._rebuild20260908: Rebuilt 2026-09-08 from hsm PR #229, merged to main as 28c29295, closing the 1-commit drift since 65dc3e599. The wasm bundle at 65dc3e599 had a real, dated defect: gating `Interop` behind `--enable-interop` (correct per §6.1.32 — "SHALL NOT be available in a production server") used `DepsConfig::default()` for the wasm build, which silently inherited the new default of OFF with no command line to opt back in. Every OASIS transcript opens with `Interop Begin`, so the hub's in-browser corpus replay failed at message #0 of 21 transcripts (all BL-M-* and the PQC interop set) — caught by this hub's own gate, not by anything in hsm, since the native harness passes `--enable-interop` explicitly and never noticed. #229 sets `interop_enabled: true` in wasm/src/lib.rs specifically because this bundle is the in-browser playground, not a production server. Rebuilt fresh from a clean detached checkout of origin/main (not the local KMIP remediation worktree, to keep provenance honest against the actual merged commit). pqctoday_kmip_wasm_bg.wasm: 6017786 -> 6185943 bytes, sha256 d170a782a4ee4a1f4d88f5ef9c6718ec74329ed4df874df39cf1a72a96788230. Build's own smoke suite passed end-to-end in wasm (engine bootstrap, OASIS Query/Create, malformed-frame path, ML-DSA-65 CreateKeyPair/Sign/SignatureVerify, Falcon-512 rejection, X25519MLKEM768 hybrid KEM round trip). Also fixed in this hub commit, separately: src/wasm/kmip/corpus/xmlAst.ts carried its own stale copy of the exact bug hsm's G1 remediation (2026-09-06) fixed on the engine/Python-harness side — an alias table collapsing the KMIP 3.0 Identifier/Reference/NameReference item types down to plain TextString, silently downgrading every placeholder-bound UniqueIdentifier/Link this parser encoded and getting it rejected by the now-strict engine. That bug, not the Interop gate, was the actual cause of every AX-M-*/AKLC-M-*/PQC-read-path failure this bundle previously showed; fixing it cleared all of them outright, independent of this rebuild.

bundles._rebuild20260903: Rebuilt 2026-09-03 from hsm branch fix/ecdh1-raw-point-tag-sniff @ 25c4e48 (parent 1a1303cf, the previously-pinned main commit) via rust/build-wasm-bundle.sh. PROVISIONAL PIN — this commit is a local branch, NOT YET pushed or merged to hsm main; pending PKCS#11-hsm's own CI + review gate (real GitHub CI, --admin merge needs explicit sign-off, per this repo's own conventions). Re-pin this hsmCommit to the actual main-branch SHA once merged (may differ if squash-merged) and re-verify byte-identity before treating this as final. Fixes a real bug, not a false-drift note: C_DeriveKey(CKM_ECDH1_DERIVE) sniffed the peer point's leading 0x04 byte to decide DER-vs-raw, which a raw SEC1 point also starts with, so it misread the point's own X coordinate as a DER length whenever X[0] equalled len-2 (~1 valid raw point in 256 for P-256/P-384/P-521) and truncated it before rejecting it as unparseable -- CKR_ARGUMENTS_BAD on a spec-mandated (v3.2 'MUST accept raw octet string') input. Same class as #212 (fixed 2026-09-02, CKA_EC_POINT import path only); this fix closes the two remaining copies (the C_DeriveKey ECDH arm itself, and the ECDH-as-KEM encapsulate/decapsulate arms) behind one curve-anchored unwrap_peer_ec_point(). Found via an intermittent ~25% per-run failure in this hub's own hpkeService.test.ts hybrid cross-product (74 raw-point derives/run against fresh random keys); root-caused and fixed against the actual shipped binary, not asserted -- see hub-hpke-ecdh1-raw-point-root-cause-and-fix-plan-09032026.md (workspace root) for the full writeup, and src/wasm/softhsm/ecdh1RawPeerPoint.test.ts (new, promoted from the diagnostic probe) for a seam test that pins the fix to this exact binary. VERIFIED: hsm's own new + pre-existing ECDH/agree/hpke/hybrid/encapsulate Rust tests (79 tests) and full crate suite (487 tests) pass; a sabotage pass (temporarily reverting the fix) reproduced the exact failure the new tests exist to catch.
